title: [recoverability] the commit map of a history rewrite: spawn commit-map load (filter-repo's map, owner only, loaded once, never changed), spawn_commit_now in the integrator's and owner's readers and folds, and guards so no commit from before the rewrite lands on main
prompt:
Spawn, objective 173 [recoverability] (after none; the lead's TOP PRIORITY, 2026-11-14): the commit map of a history rewrite. The owner rewrites the Spawn repository's history at MAP LIVE (about 02:00): every changed commit gets a new id, on every ref. The event log keeps the old ids, and it is never rewritten. Before 173, every reader that compares a recorded id with git compared the old one. rev-b's survey names 11 sites. The worst is site 11: an owner's request recorded before the rewrite names its old commit. That object stays in the source (no gc), so the integrator merges the old history back into the rewritten main (owner.rs `apply`; the scenario shows it on the base). 173 adds the map, its load and the guards, and translates the integrator's and the owner's readers. 177 (after 173) translates the agents' readers, and 178 (rev-e) translates controller_behind, mission moved and the restore drill, both on 173's `store.commit_now`.

Base: live main 52f62475.

R2 (rev-g's 173 R1 F1, the lead's ruling 19:08): a task gate-accepted but not landed at the rewrite has a candidate under no ref of the source: the integrator's merge, in its mirror only, which the map cannot name. In R1, `foreign()` held it with nothing recorded, and every landing on its source waited behind it. Now it is recorded `stale`, naming why, and judged again; (6) below. Also in R2: the map's olds are only the commits the rewrite changed or dropped. filter-repo lists an unchanged commit as itself, and R1's `pre_rewrite` would have refused one outside main. R1 is kept under r1/.

Read first:
- crates/spawn-cli/src/integrate/owner.rs (`apply`);
- crates/spawn-cli/src/integrate/landing.rs (`land`);
- crates/spawn-postgres/src/missions.rs (GATED, SOURCE_PUSHES_PENDING, MAIN_LANDING, SOURCE_OWNER_LANDED);
- crates/spawn-postgres/sql/schema.sql (the `source.moved` and `task.gated` folds, `spawn_source_moved`).

What changes:
(1) The table spawn_commit_map (`old` is the primary key, 40 hex; `new` is 40 hex or null for a commit the rewrite dropped). A statement trigger refuses update, delete and truncate: "the commit map is never changed (objective 173): % refused". The table is revoked from public.
(2) `spawn_commit_now(text)` is SQL, stable and security definer, with search_path pinned. It returns the map's `new` for a recorded id (case-insensitive), and the id itself otherwise: an id from after the rewrite, a dropped commit's id, or one the map does not hold. Null stays null.
(3) `spawn_commit_map_load(jsonb)` is owner only. It takes a non-empty array of [old, new|null] pairs, malformed or duplicate olds refused. It locks the table, then:
   - on an empty table, inserts all the pairs and returns the count;
   - given exactly the pairs already held, returns that count and changes nothing;
   - given anything else, refuses: "a different commit map is loaded (% pairs): a map is loaded once and never changed".
(4) `spawn commit-map load <file> --source <git dir>` reads git filter-repo's `.git/filter-repo/commit-map`: its header, then "old new" lines; a new of forty zeros is a dropped commit; an error names the line. It checks every new is a commit of the source (`git cat-file --batch-check`), otherwise: "N new commit(s) of the map are not commits of <source> (the first: …): nothing loaded". Then it loads and prints either "commit map: N pair(s) loaded (D dropped commit(s))" or "commit map: the same N pair(s) are loaded already; nothing changed".
(5) These read through the map:
   - the readers: GATED (a mission's baseline, a task's base and candidate), SOURCE_PUSHES_PENDING (the request's commit; `spawn mission pushes`, SOURCE_PUSHES, shows the record as it is), MAIN_LANDING (moved_to, its anchor, owner_requests' commit), SOURCE_OWNER_LANDED, and alerts.rs CONTROLLERS (landed);
   - the folds: `source.moved`'s baseline = from, `task.gated`'s floor baseline = base (twice), `spawn_source_moved`'s baseline = from and its halt's from/to, and the two "baseline = from and not halted" matches. Each fold compares both sides through spawn_commit_now.
(6) The guards:
   - landing.rs `foreign()`: before a landing pushes, it checks the candidate descends from its base. One that does not (a gate verdict recorded before the rewrite: the integrator's merge commit lives only in its mirror, so the map cannot name it) is never pushed. `land()` records the verdict `stale` with the reason: the candidate was dropped by the rewrite, an unknown commit (in neither the map nor the source), or "the candidate C does not descend from its base B". The task goes back to `reported` and is judged again on its checkpoint (177 translates that), as when main moves past a candidate. Nothing is held unrecorded, so other tasks on the source keep landing (rev-g R1 F1). The push itself is unchanged: the lease on the base, as before.
   - owner.rs `pre_rewrite()`: with a map loaded, a request for a dropped commit is refused ("was dropped by the history rewrite: push it again from the rewritten history"). So is one whose `rev-list <commit> --not main` holds an old id of the map that the rewrite changed or dropped ("would bring N commit(s) from before the history rewrite onto main (the first: …)"). An empty map changes nothing.
(7) `PostgresStore::commit_map_load`, `commit_now`, `commit_map_size`, `commit_map_entry` and `commit_map_olds` (crates/spawn-postgres/src/commit_map.rs). `commit_map_olds` names the olds the rewrite changed or dropped (`new` is another id or null), never an unchanged commit.

What stays as it is:
- the event log (no record is rewritten);
- refs/spawn-owner/<old>, which keep their names (the lead);
- report_to_live (it joins by time);
- spawn_deploy_record (it compares nothing);
- every reader 177 and 178 own;
- everything when no map is loaded.

Polled reads: spawn_commit_now is one primary-key lookup per value read. GATED reads it 1 + 2 × tasks times a pass, and the others once a row. Timing on live (read-only), before and after the table exists:
  psql "$SPAWN_DATABASE_URL" -c "explain analyze select spawn_commit_now(baseline) from mission_missions"
Before the table exists, time the same select without the call. Expected under 1 ms; the lead times it.

Tests:
- crates/spawn-postgres/tests/commit_map.rs (new): an_owner_request_of_a_pre_rewrite_commit_is_read_as_its_new_commit (site 11 first); the_map_is_loaded_once_by_the_owner_and_never_changed (with the supervisor's refusal by the function's grant); the_integrators_readers_and_folds_read_recorded_commits_as_their_new_ones (with the gated floor on the new base and the deploy anchor on the old deployed id); an_owners_move_clears_a_halt_recorded_before_the_rewrite.
- spawn-cli: commit_map::tests::a_filter_repo_commit_map_is_read_as_pairs_and_its_dropped_commits_as_none; integrate::landing::tests::a_landing_candidate_that_does_not_descend_from_its_base_is_named_why; integrate::database_tests::a_landing_candidate_that_does_not_descend_from_its_base_is_never_pushed (through `land()`: the verdict is recorded `stale` naming why, main is unchanged, and the task is `reported`; without the guard the lease on the base holds and the push replaces main).

Files: crates/spawn-cli/src/commit_map.rs (new), crates/spawn-cli/src/main.rs, crates/spawn-cli/src/integrate/landing.rs, crates/spawn-cli/src/integrate/owner.rs, crates/spawn-cli/src/integrate/database_tests.rs, crates/spawn-postgres/sql/schema.sql, crates/spawn-postgres/src/commit_map.rs (new), crates/spawn-postgres/src/lib.rs, crates/spawn-postgres/src/missions.rs, crates/spawn-postgres/src/alerts.rs, crates/spawn-postgres/tests/commit_map.rs (new). rsi/scenarios/173.sh is the owner's (173-owner.diff). Two crates, as the lead approved.
Size: +906 −19 in all: code +421 −19 (schema +99 −9, readers +14 −10, store API 63, CLI 133, guards 112); tests +485 (the in-file unit tests 120, the database test 53, store tests 318); 173.sh 372 (owner).

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/173.sh, black box through `spawn mission push`, `spawn integrate --once` and `spawn commit-map load`. The scenario rewrites a source as filter-repo would:
- the root m0 is unchanged;
- m1 is rewritten to m1';
- an empty E is dropped;
- X is rewritten to X';
- the old objects stay in the source; main and refs/spawn-owner/<X> move to the new history.
Before the rewrite, an owner's landing moved the mission's main to m1, and the owner's request for X (on E on m1) is recorded but not applied.
(1) The map loads ("4 pair(s) loaded (1 dropped commit(s))"). After one pass, main is X', `source.moved` goes from m1' to X', main's history holds none of m1, E or X, and the mission is not halted, its baseline X'. A task gate-accepted while the owner held the source before the rewrite (its work W on m0, so its candidate C is the integrator's merge of W into m1, under no ref of the source; the hold is released after the rewrite) is never pushed: its verdict is `stale` naming why ("the candidate C does not descend from its base m1'", or "the base m1' is an unknown commit …" while the integrator's mirror has not fetched m1'), C is not in main's history, and the task is `reported`.
(2) A request for Z, made on the old X after the rewrite, is refused: "would bring 3 commit(s) from before the history rewrite onto main". Main is unchanged.
(3) A request for E is refused: "was dropped by the history rewrite".
(4) Loading the same map again prints "the same 4 pair(s) are loaded already". A different map exits 1 with "a different commit map is loaded". A map naming a commit the source lacks exits 1 with "not commits of". The table still holds 4 pairs.
(5) The event log's records before the load are unchanged (md5).
On the base (52f62475), 173.sh exits 1: "(1) spawn commit-map load exited 1: spawn: unknown command commit-map", "(1) main after the request recorded with the old X: expected [X'], got [m1']", "(1) the request's source.moved: expected [{from m1', to X'}], got []", "(1) the mission after the pass: expected [not halted X'], got [not halted …]" (its baseline is not X'), and on to (2) to (4).

Proof (rev-b, sync/obj-173/173-proof.txt, run173.sh), R2 at 570e04ba: the base fails (1) to (4) and the fix passes twice. The unit and database tests (6), store tests (4), fmt and clippy pass. The kept scenarios 056 061 063 076 096 131 check-j08-stuck check-j11-push-drain pass. Test lists go 1372 → 1379, 0 missing, 7 new.
31 mutants (mut173.py) ran each alone, each its own binary, and all were killed.
- R2 ran the mutants whose code R2 changed or added again: land-no-foreign, foreign-no-dropped, foreign-no-unknown (at 89247b5c) and olds-unchanged, land-no-foreign (at 570e04ba). The other 26 are R1's runs (r1/173-proof.txt), on code R2 leaves as it was.
- 173.sh fails on 13: now-identity, load-same-refused, load-different-taken, no-trigger, fold-moved-record, fold-moved-halted, pending-commit, owner-no-pre-rewrite, pre-rewrite-no-dropped, pre-rewrite-no-olds, cli-no-missing, cli-zeros-kept, and land-no-foreign (new in R2, rev-g N2: the task accepted before the rewrite would be pushed).
- Only tests kill the other 18:
  - map rules no scenario input reaches: now-case, load-twice-named, load-malformed, load-not-owner-only, olds-unchanged (173.sh's unchanged m0 is in main);
  - folds and readers the scenario's single mission never compares: fold-gated-floor, fold-source-moved, fold-halt-from-to, gated-baseline/base/candidate, landing-owner-requests, landing-moved-to, landing-anchor, owner-landed, alert-landed;
  - foreign-no-dropped and foreign-no-unknown (the scenario's candidate is neither dropped nor unknown to the mirror).
At MAP LIVE (rev-g N1):
- tasks in `landing`: the lead's runbook freezes landings so none is left in `landing` when the rewrite starts. One that is left is recorded `stale` at its next pass, as above, and judged again;
- tasks being gated: their verdict names the old base. If accepted, the landing check above makes it `stale`; if rejected, the rejection stands (it was judged on the same trees).

Verified by: the gate runs 173.sh on the candidate. At MAP LIVE, the owner runs `spawn commit-map load .git/filter-repo/commit-map --source <the source>` and posts its line. Then `select count(*) from spawn_commit_map` equals the file's pair count, and the next integrate pass posts the owner's request applied (or refused by its reason), never a merge of old commits.
rev-g reviews (deleter-grade).
